## `client.environments`

The `environments` resource of the platform API.

### `client.environments.create`

Signature: `client.environments.create(name: str, storage: dict[str, Any]) -> Environment`

Create an environment.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's unique name. |
| `storage` | `dict[str, Any]` | required | Storage configuration: `{"scheme", "root", "options"}`. The root is in the scheme `scheme` names: `file:///data/lakana` for `file`, `s3://bucket/lakana` for `s3`, `abfs://container/lakana` for `abfs`. |

Returns: `Environment`. The created environment.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.Conflict` | If an environment of this name already exists. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If the root is in another scheme than `scheme`, or is refused for another reason; the message names the root to use. |

### `client.environments.delete`

Signature: `client.environments.delete(name: str, *, purge: bool = False) -> Environment | None`

Delete an environment: its tables can be restored with `restore` until `purge_after`.

Every managed table becomes a dropped table whose files the server's clean-up deletes after the undo period (`LAKANA_TABLES__UNDO_DAYS`, 7 days by default); views and external tables are removed, and an external table's files are never deleted.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's name. |
| `purge` | `bool` | `False` | Make everything due at once: the next clean-up deletes the files, and the environment cannot be restored. Also accepted for an environment already deleted. |

Returns: `Environment or None`. The deleted environment, with `deleted_at` and `purge_after`; `None` from a server older than environment restore, which kept the files for ever.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no environment of this name exists, or it is already deleted and `purge` is false. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If a repository is still deployed to it; undeploy first. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If it is protected. |

### `client.environments.restore`

Signature: `client.environments.restore(name: str) -> Environment`

Restore a deleted environment within its undo period, with the tables it dropped.

The tables come back with the same ids, data and grants; a table dropped before the environment was deleted stays dropped (`Tables.undrop` restores it).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's name. |

Returns: `Environment`. The restored environment.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no environment of this name exists. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If it is not deleted, its undo period has ended, or the clean-up has started deleting its files. |

### `client.environments.purge_rows`

Signature: `client.environments.purge_rows(name: str) -> None`

Remove a deleted environment whose storage cannot be reached, rows only.

For an environment the worker's clean-up skips because its storage cannot be resolved (a root in a scheme Lakana cannot read, such as ``local://``): it is removed from the catalog with its records of dropped tables, and its name is free again. Its files, if there are any, are not touched. Needs ``MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT`` on the instance.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's name. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no environment of this name exists. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If it is not deleted, its storage can still be reached (the clean-up deletes it then; `delete(name, purge=True)` makes that happen at the next clean-up), or its root contains ``::`` (releases before 0.18.0 wrote files to the part before it). |

### `client.environments.set_retention`

Signature: `client.environments.set_retention(name: str, days: int | None) -> Environment`

Set the retention of an environment's tables that set none of their own.

A table then expires `days` after its last activity (the later of its last change and its last recorded read), and never earlier than `days` after this call. Tables in a protected environment never expire. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the environment.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's name. |
| `days` | `int | None` | required | 1 to 3,650 days, or `None` to turn the retention off. |

Returns: `Environment`. The environment.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no environment of this name exists. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `days` is out of range, or the environment is protected. |

### `client.environments.usage`

Signature: `client.environments.usage(name: str) -> EnvironmentUsage`

Report how much storage an environment uses.

The server adds up what the catalog database holds and reads nothing from object storage: the sizes of managed tables are the ones the worker's hourly sweep measured, so a table written since counts as `unmeasured` until the next sweep. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the environment.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's name. |

Returns: `EnvironmentUsage`. Its tables, dropped tables, artifacts and code archives.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no environment of this name exists. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | Without `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the environment. |

### `client.environments.orphaned_locations`

Signature: `client.environments.orphaned_locations(name: str, *, older_than_days: int = 30) -> OrphanedLocations`

List the table directories older releases left without a location record.

A dry run: nothing is deleted. Needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT` on the instance; a deleted environment is accepted.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's name. |
| `older_than_days` | `int` | `30` | A directory with a file newer than this many days (1 to 3,650) is listed as recent and is never deleted. |

Returns: `OrphanedLocations`. The directories; `complete` is false when the server's time limit cut the listing.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no environment of this name exists. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `older_than_days` is out of range. |

### `client.environments.delete_orphaned_locations`

Signature: `client.environments.delete_orphaned_locations(name: str, *, older_than_days: int = 30) -> OrphanedLocations`

Delete the table directories without a location record whose files are old enough.

Each directory is checked again first; one that a table, a create or a dropped table now uses is kept, with the reason. Audited. Call again while `complete` is false.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The environment's name. |
| `older_than_days` | `int` | `30` | Only directories whose newest file is older than this many days are deleted. |

Returns: `OrphanedLocations`. Each directory, deleted or with the reason it was kept.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no environment of this name exists. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `older_than_days` is out of range. |
